_about: Stat-shaped emphasis (List 35, #341): the Chao type-by-stat grammar translated (a Run-raised Chao becomes a Run-type, read off the body). Emphasis is the derived class #337's proportion channel speaks — the capability a life was built around, in presentation only. Born talent (#80 variance), care grades (#293), and raised emphasis are three separate facts and are NEVER merged into a true-nature score.

inputs.careEmphasis: dominant care axis across the #28/#293 history (feeding, gifts, lessons)
inputs.keptApart: #80 variance (born) and #293 grades (care talent) are NOT inputs — a born-swift individual raised gentle reads gentle-emphasised with its variance intact underneath
inputs.workEmphasis: dominant capability across #338 family 4 (battles and how fought, #294 sports, field life)

speaksIn: #337's proportion-emphasis channel only (secondary read: #152 behaviour selection); settles at growth moments with the rest of drift

theLine.claim: emphasis is how a life SHOWS, never what it SCORES — battle stats remain base + #80 variance + #39 effort + #178 growth, earned in battle/training, read by #17; care-sport performance is #294's axes, not looks
theLine.enforcement: schema-level (#293's method): the emphasis output has NO field capable of naming a battle stat

vocabulary.contents: the final class list + per-family renderings (sturdy on a plant body vs a beast body) are art-lane data beside the sheets
vocabulary.shape: a small closed set of readable builds (swift-built / sturdy-built / soaring / grounded / bright / gentle / fierce is the shape); below the pattern threshold an individual reads UNEMPHASISED — the plain sheet, and the common case for young lives
